Key Capabilities

Everything a SysAdmin & Developer Needs

Engineered to replace sluggish, fragmented tools with a fast, reliable, all-in-one native terminal solution.

Productivity

Multi-Tab & Split Terminal

Organize multiple local and remote sessions at once. Open independent tabs or split screens horizontally and vertically to compare logs side by side.

Orchestration

Multi-Input Broadcast

Type once and send keystrokes to all open terminals simultaneously. Ideal for patching clusters, restarting services, or querying status across machines.

Files

Integrated SFTP Browser

Browse remote directory trees in the sidebar, transfer files with drag-and-drop, manage permissions, and edit remote configuration files in-place.

Security

SSH Tunnels (Local, Remote, SOCKS5)

Easily configure local, remote, and dynamic SOCKS5 port forwarding. Bypass firewalls and securely reach private cluster databases with one click.

Telemetry

Live Remote System Monitoring

Monitor CPU load, RAM utilization, disk capacity, and uptime in real time right in the status bar of every connected SSH session.

Hardware

Serial Console & ZMODEM

Direct connection to UART/RS-232 hardware, network switches, and IoT microcontrollers with configurable baudrates and XMODEM/ZMODEM file transfers.

Networking

FTP / FTPS with TLS 1.3

Secure FTP connections with strict certificate validation, passive mode, custom CA bundles, and resilient auto-reconnect on network drops.

Performance

100% Native C++17 & Qt 6

Zero Chromium or Electron bloat. Instant startup, ultra-low typing latency, and minimal RAM footprint powered by an in-process QTermWidget engine.

Customization

Themes, Palettes & i18n

Dark and light interface modes, customizable terminal color schemes, and native internationalization in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

True Multi-Protocol

All Your Connection Channels in One Tool

From cloud clusters to serial console cables in your server rack: administer modern infrastructure and network hardware without switching apps.

Remote Access

SSH & X11

Robust SSH connections powered by libssh2. Supports public/private keys (Ed25519, RSA), SSH agents, secure passwords, and graphical X11 forwarding.

  • Protected key-based auth and SSH Agent integration
  • X11 GUI forwarding (auto-launches companion VcXsrv on Windows)
  • Built-in SSH tunnel manager: Local, Remote, and Dynamic SOCKS5
  • Native Linux Secret Service integration (GNOME Keyring / KWallet)
File Explorer

SFTP & Transfer

A remote file manager always available in the sidebar. No need to launch separate FTP tools like FileZilla or WinSCP just to tweak a config file.

  • Remote tree browser displaying permissions, ownership, and sizes
  • Upload and download via seamless drag & drop within the app
  • In-app editor to modify server configuration files directly
  • Background transfer engine without interrupting active shell sessions
Hardware & IoT

Serial Console & ZMODEM

Built for network engineers, sysadmins, and embedded developers working with Cisco switches, Mikrotik routers, or dev boards.

  • Compatible with picocom, screen, and minicom workflows
  • Hardware COM port and /dev/ttyUSB* autodetect with baudrate picker
  • Direct firmware and file transfer via XMODEM and YMODEM
  • Native ZMODEM file sending through integrated 'sz' (lrzsz)
Classic Protocols

FTP / Secure FTPS

Access traditional file storage servers backed by modern cryptographic layers with TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 support.

  • Modern FTPS encryption with TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3-only options
  • Custom CA bundle validation and self-signed certificate policies
  • Recursive folder transfer, queue pausing, and cancellation
  • Resilient automatic reconnect handling unstable networks
The native advantage

Open the app. Connect. Work.

BanchoXterm brings your connections to the desktop with C++17 and Qt 6. The interface runs directly on your computer, without a browser or an intermediary web server.

Spend your time on your servers: no Docker installation, containers to maintain, or web ports, volumes and encryption keys to configure for deploying the tool.

FeatureBanchoXtermDocker-based web solution
InterfaceNative: C++17 + Qt 6Browser + backend + connection engine
Additional infrastructureNo Docker or web serverDocker and a running web service
Initial setupOpen the app and create your sessionContainer, networking, volume and encryption key
Your network and VPNDirectly from your computerFrom the server or container network
